explain: Reciprocity refers to the mutual exchange between living things (biotic) and the non-living environment (abiotic), such as nutrient cycling.

q: 5. 'A nectar sipping butterfly -> Dragon fly -> Frog -> Snake -> Hawk' is ............
explain: This is a grazing or predator food chain because it starts with a producer and moves up through successive levels of predators.
